newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices slide on increased offerings.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices slide on increased offerings.

text.p: Indian castor prices (December delivery) slid by 12 rupees to 1,112/1,113 rupees per quintal on Tuesday on increased offerings, dealers said.
"New crop arrivals are around the corner and the market is still facing the pressure of arrivals from the old crop which triggered heavy bull liquidation," one dealer said.

He said the absence of fresh export buying also kept the market down, adding "December delivery may slid to 1,100 rupees". Groundnut oil was steady at the reduced level of 410/412 rupees per 10 kg on stray physical buying ahead of festivals coupled with restricted inflows of 40/50 tonnes.
